_what: One demo per component of the A2UI Basic Catalog, in the shape the published schema actually specifies — Button names itself from a child Text, Image carries `description`, Tabs holds `tabs[].child`, Modal holds `trigger`/`content`, and List uses a TEMPLATE over a collection so relative paths resolve inside each item. `extra` are the additional flat components a demo needs; A2UI has no inline children.

data.intro: Households may bring waste **free of charge** twice a month. Book a 30-minute slot below; bring proof of address.

extra.text: Garden waste, untreated wood, metal, rubble, paper, glass and small appliances.
Asbestos, gas bottles, fireworks and car tyres. These go to the chemical depot on Keilestraat.
Proof of address is checked at the barrier. Loads over 2 m³ are charged at the commercial rate. Trailers are counted separately.
